claims.title: Historical downside and recovery risk
claims.upgrade_condition: Replicate episodes on the same raw-share and cash ledger with resolved valuation gaps, and compare distinct target definitions without selecting winners.
claims.invalidating_evidence: A source, return-clock or accounting correction invalidates the stated historical episode; a quiet future interval does not erase past drawdowns.
claims.resumption_trigger: Reopen on input revisions, missing marks, different observation clocks or recovery-definition changes.

claims.title: Low turnover beyond size and liquidity
claims.upgrade_condition: Require the prespecified common-support contrast and intervals to persist in new frozen prospective observations; retain attrition and all comparator outcomes.
claims.invalidating_evidence: A consistent sign reversal or loss of the prespecified relation on adequate future complete observations weakens the predictive claim; a single month is not decisive.
claims.resumption_trigger: Review every completed frozen interval, and do not retune the rule after inspecting it.

claims.title: Executable capacity at a stated capital level
claims.upgrade_condition: Require reconciled raw shares, cash, entitlements, settlement, missing quotes and delistings; source-bound execution/impact calibration and fixed targets, dates, costs and order policy.
claims.invalidating_evidence: Unresolved entitled cash or shares, valuation mismatches, impossible fills or uncalibrated execution invalidate a readiness claim at the stated scope.
claims.resumption_trigger: Reopen on any blocker resolution, new action type, participation-policy or fee change; no capital grid substitutes for the ledger.

claims.title: Support-policy rescoring changes target paths
claims.upgrade_condition: Replicate the frozen same-input interventions with complete score/eligibility provenance and report their limited scope, not historical-runtime attribution.
claims.invalidating_evidence: Failure of equal raw means or identical-support score parity would invalidate the current mechanism attribution.
claims.resumption_trigger: Reopen if feature construction, eligibility, standardization or buffer implementations change.

claims.title: Completed full-window query evidence for frozen targets
claims.upgrade_condition: Independent action-event completeness and raw-share readiness require separate announcement and entitlement audits; query completion alone is never upgraded to these claims.
claims.invalidating_evidence: A failed or truncated request, hash mismatch, uncovered target name or insufficient declared window reopens the query-evidence gap.
claims.resumption_trigger: Recheck on target-universe changes, new input vintages or provider corrections; preserve prior receipts.

claims.title: Original published 120-session runtime identity
claims.upgrade_condition: Require an original invocation and code/input/target/daily-output binding consistent with the published row, including its support and prehistory rules.
claims.invalidating_evidence: A newly tuned matching summary is insufficient; inconsistent target/daily evidence rejects a candidate historical runtime.
claims.resumption_trigger: Resume only on a named previously uninspected archive, original invocation or runtime receipt; no repetitive unrestricted disk search.
